verdict.rationale: Before a run starts, Marlin narrows the direction and scope of the investigation through a brief exchange with the user and builds a research plan from the requested topic. Once the course is set, it runs autonomously without further human input, and the only documented mid-run action is cancellation, which does not steer the run. missing for 10: explicit depth/effort controls (runs appear fixed at up to ~8 hours and 100 credits per run), in-flight steering or redirection, documented scope parameters beyond the initial conversation, independent hands-on corroboration.
